source_type: Official Indonesian Government KNB Scholarship portal
funding_classification_basis: The official KNB portal states that the scholarship covers tuition, monthly living expenses, arrival allowance, book and research allowance, publication assistance, transportation for arrival and return, and monthly health insurance.
unresolved_fields: one exact GPA threshold because the threshold differs by degree
one exact age limit because age rules differ by degree
one exact English score because requirements differ by degree
notes: KNB is a multi-university Indonesian Government scholarship and therefore host_university_id is intentionally None. The 2026 application period ran from 2 February through 31 March 2026.

source_type: Official Universitas Indonesia International Office scholarship page
funding_classification_basis: NEW UI GREAT 2026 publishes both Full and Partial scholarship tiers. The Full tier includes tuition waiver, visa and stay-permit processing, airfare reimbursement, settlement allowance, health insurance and IDR 3.5 million monthly living allowance. The Partial tier provides tuition waiver and immigration-processing support.
unresolved_fields: exact machine-readable scholarship application dates because the current timeline is presented as an image
notes: funding_type is Variable Funding because applicants may receive either the Full or Partial tier. Full-tier living, travel and insurance benefits are kept in evidence rather than assigned to all recipients in the canonical structured fields.

source_type: Official Universitas Gadjah Mada international admission scholarship announcement
funding_classification_basis: The official UGM DEIE announcement provides tuition fees, student dormitory accommodation and IDR 3 million monthly living expenses for both Master's and Doctoral recipients.
unresolved_fields: complete nationality list because the call is presented broadly for international students
notes: Minimum academic GPA is 3.25/4.0. English evidence is alternative-based: TOEFL ITP 500, IELTS 5.5, TOEFL iBT 61, or Duolingo 100. Numeric English hard-filter fields remain None to avoid treating alternatives as simultaneous requirements. Spring registration closed 31 July 2026.

source_type: Official ITB School of Architecture, Planning and Policy Development international undergraduate page
funding_classification_basis: The official ITB Architecture international undergraduate page describes the 2026 scholarship as fully funded with 100% tuition waiver, one-time arrival settlement support, basic health insurance, monthly living allowance, round-trip international flights and visa fees.
notes: The scholarship is intentionally scoped to Architecture rather than generalized to every ITB program. Maximum age is 22 by 1 August 2026. English eligibility accepts IELTS 5.5, TOEFL iBT 61, or ITB ELQ as alternatives. Application deadline was 1 July 2026.
